description: When a core source file changes, check it against the spec's requirements and flag any drift before work continues.
name: spec-check-on-save

then.prompt: A file under skeleton-core/src just changed. Compare it against .kiro/specs/skeleton-core/requirements.md and design.md. If the change drifts from the spec (new behaviour not in the requirements, or a requirement the code no longer meets), say exactly what drifted and whether the code or the spec should move. If there is no drift, say so in one line.
